actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием ближнего боя: +6 к попаданию, досягаемость 5 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 13 (2к8+4) колющего урона.
actions.name: Gore

actions.desc: The minotaur labyrinth keeper makes two attacks: one with its gore and one with its shortsword.
actions.desc_ru: Мультиатака. Существо совершает 2 атаки: одну — атака «Горе»; одну — атака «Короткий меч».
actions.name: Multiattack

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием ближнего боя: +7 к попаданию, досягаемость 5 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 11 (2к6+4) колющего урона.
actions.name: Shortsword

traits.desc: If the labyrinth keeper moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

traits.name: Charge

traits.desc:
The minotaur labyrinth keeper's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: acid arrow, fire bolt, locate object, misty step
2/day each: inflict wounds, stone shape

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting

traits.desc: The minotaur labyrinth keeper can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.
traits.desc_ru: Особенность «Лабйринтине Рекалл». Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).

traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the minotaur labyrinth keeper can gain advantage on all spell attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.
